headline: Pillay’s Case for International Law
lede: The Nobel Committee honors Navanethem “Navi” Pillay for advancing the prosecution of war crimes, crimes against humanity, and genocide. Her career makes the award a measured defense of tribunals and treaties as instruments of accountability in a fractured order.

headline: DeepSeek Makes Cheap Intelligence Ordinary
lede: DeepSeek 4.1 Flash turns frontier-level coding and research into an inexpensive, always-available utility. Its reported 437-fold reduction in KV-cache size points to a quieter shift: efficiency may matter more than spectacle in the next phase of AI infrastructure.

headline: Speech Recognition Fits in 16.9 MB
lede: Whistle brings multilingual speech recognition to phones, wearables, vehicles, and microcontrollers without a cloud connection. Its small CPU-friendly model trades some benchmark advantages for privacy, low latency, and a footprint that can travel almost anywhere.

headline: MXC Puts Untrusted Code Behind Policy
lede: Microsoft’s MXC provides one interface for running hostile or AI-generated code across processes, containers, microVMs, and virtual machines. Define the policy. Choose the backend. Inspect the boundary.

headline: The Coffee Maker That Ate a Terabyte
lede: A smart coffee machine generated roughly 1 TB of local network traffic in ten days, saturating its owners’ Wi-Fi. Whether the culprit was a firmware bug, a reporting error, or something stranger, the remedy was refreshingly direct: unplug the appliance.

headline: Why Windows and Mac Keys Disagree
lede: Command is not Control, Delete is not always Delete, and Home may not take you where you expect. This practical guide maps the platform conventions that developers must respect when shortcuts, text editing, accessibility, and international layouts meet.

headline: A Floor Plan Becomes a Smart-Home Interface
lede: An illustrated house plan becomes a live Home Assistant dashboard, with layered artwork, animated states, and carefully arranged controls. The hard part was not the YAML; it was coordinating pixels, devices, file formats, and a household’s patience.

headline: AI Changes Coding; Fundamentals Stay
lede: AI can produce code quickly, but reliable software still depends on judgment, architecture, communication, and the ability to understand what was produced. The essay’s advice is practical: use language models as assistants, while giving beginners enough real work to develop intuition.
pullquote: The less code we write by hand, the more important it becomes to understand what code means.

headline: Theranos Returns as a Digital Ghost
lede: Theranos.world recreates the company’s polished devices, offices, and interfaces as a navigable browser experience. Its playful, Flash-era surface makes the old promise tangible—and leaves the distance between presentation and reality to speak for itself.

headline: The Case for Taking the Long Way
lede: Small talk is not always a detour; sometimes it is the bridge that makes honesty possible. This reflective essay considers how meals, pauses, and ordinary conversation build the trust that directness alone cannot summon.
